author: GamingBolt
description: Crimson Desert is an overwhelming experience, and it never really stops throughout the dozens upon dozens of campaign hours. However, additional systems and features become unlocked as you progress, and they can make many things a fair bit easier if you go out of your way. Let's delve into it all, starting with...
title: Crimson Desert - 15 Advanced Tips The Game Doesn't Tell You

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert is almost here, and we've been diving into Pywel almost constantly over the past few days, and coming away even more impressed with how its world is designed every time we do. 

This one's special, we can tell you that. Not only is the world quite challenging to navigate, but doing so makes for a gameplay loop that makes even a solid narrative take the backseat. 

It's got distractions that are most welcome, each one taking you in a direction different to the one you started out with, and leading you to even more ways to engage with the world at large. Exploring the world isn't forced, but becomes so natural that we felt compelled to tell you about it. Join us and learn more about why Pywel's become our favorite digital destination for our leisure time.
title: Why Crimson Desert’s World Is Just WOW
